nota: Tiempos exactos: la pista es la concatenación de los audios de cada segmento con pausas fijas.

segmentos.texto: Mei: Hi, Ben!
What do you usually do on weekends?
I need some ideas.
My weekends are really boring!
Ben: Hi, Mei!
Well, on Saturday mornings I always play football with some friends in the park.
After that, I usually have lunch with my parents.
Mei: Football?
I hate running!
What about Sundays?
Ben: On Sundays I often go to the cinema.
I sometimes cook something new, because I love cooking.
And once a month, I go hiking in the mountains with my cousin.
Mei: Hiking sounds great!
How often do you go to the cinema?
Ben: About twice a month.
I never go on Saturdays, because it's very busy.
Do you like films?
Mei: Yes, I love films!
But I rarely go to the cinema, because the tickets are expensive.
I usually watch films at home.
Ben: There's a cheap cinema near your house.
The tickets are only five dollars on Sundays.
Do you want to come next Sunday?
Mei: Yes, great idea!
See you on Sunday!
